channel.description: Latest articles from The Butler Collegian (thebutlercollegian.com)

item.title: Beyond the box score: Men’s basketball stomped by No. 25 St. John’s
item.description: “From the moment the ball was tipped in Madison Square Garden, it was all St. John’s as the Red Storm flexed their muscles in a wire-to-wire 92-70 triumph over the men’s basketball team.”

item.title: Newfields opens its doors for College Night
item.description: Newfields is hosting a special event for college students January 30. Multimedia Reporter Blaine Raider previews the event.

item.title: Dawgs on the Street: Snow, snow, snow
item.description: The winter weather system that affected most of the country during the last week of January hit Butler hard. Multimedia Reporter Will Hicks talks with students about what they did during the snowstorm, and how the administration handled working around it.

item.title: What you need to know: Butler men’s basketball hosts Georgetown in Saturday matinee
item.description: Junior guard Finley Bizjack is averaging 18 points per game in conference play. Photo by Jada Gangazha. DAVID JACOBS | MANAGING EDITOR | drjacobs@butler.edu Following a ghastly outing on the road against No. 25 St. John’s, the men’s basketball team is in dire need of a win against Georgetown to cling to any sort of...

item.title: What you need to know: Bulldogs seek to get on track against Musketeers
item.description: “If the Dawgs can continue shooting the ball well and limit their mistakes, then they will have an easy path to victory against Xavier again.”

item.title: Bulldogs suffer disastrous loss to Georgetown
item.description: “The adjustments did not work, with Butler suffering arguably its most brutal loss this season, likely crushing any remaining tournament hopes for Bulldog faithful.”
